_doc: Configs and invariants for §6 generators: historical A/S reference, X/Omega roadmap coverage (not v1, D3/D4), and approved hybrid design. Reference facts are not automatic hybrid requirements; owner-approved rules and exceptions in ontology/domain/index.md take precedence. Regional gear power loss is permanently excluded, even for cloning fidelity.

boss.alpha-spirit-drop: A / hybrid: one per eligible non-mission boss kill, fixed type+level per boss; mission bosses (including Saurians) drop none, normal mission rewards unchanged

climate.bands: see landscapes.json climate; devlog: high temp + high humidity → jungle

design._doc: Owner-approved hybrid tunables, governed by the rules in ../domain/3_Classes.md, ../domain/5_Constraints.md and ../domain/6_Generators.md. Later approved hybrid rules take precedence over earlier approximations. Historical flags and reference facts do not resolve open choices. Tune in play.

abilities._doc: D21 (2026-09-10): every class node and ultimate of abilities.json#alpha-tree has one runtime here. runtime: dash = move `distance` blocks (`toward` target = nearest enemy within `range`, else forward | forward | back) at dash-speed, then `strike` (radius, damage-mult, at end | origin); channel = Cyclone rotates clockwise at turns-per-s from activation facing, current-position azimuth contacts once per enemy per revolution, front-only initial contact, inclusive exact final contact; clip active time to duration-s and affordable drain-per-s (zero drain legal), stop body at reached angle without rotating camera or changing normal controls; radius/damage-mult, movement × move-mult, stamina drain-per-s on top of cost; burst = instant self-centred strike (damage-mult 0 = no damage, taunt only) + optional heal-pct (over heal-over-s); buff = timed self status (damage-mult, damage-taken-mult, move-mult, swing-mult, crit-add, absorb-pct-hp, stun-immune, charge-mult); heal = cast-s then heal-pct of max HP. Strikes apply the ability's `applies` through design.status-effects. cost: mp (c-mp-range) / stamina, a number or 'all' (needs ≥ all-min, spends the bar). cooldown-s: the sources' S value where numeric, else designed here (cyclone A said ~60). Per point (D6, design.skill-point): strike damage, heal-pct and buff duration × effect-mult; cooldown × cooldown-mult. Tune in play.

artifact.stats: Exactly one of key-items.json#artifact.stat-kinds plus attack and max HP. x is the nonnegative integer contributor count: matching artifacts per traversal stat, all artifacts for attack/max HP. Adjustable z > 0; B(0) = 0; first = B(1). Equal current shares B(x)/x for x > 0 are additive, never compounded. Recalculate current artifact-free stat * (1 + B(x)) when ordinary inputs change; no cap, decay or per-artifact floor.
artifact.total-bonus: B(x) = first * ln(1 + z * x) / ln(1 + z)

design.block-reward: mp (D11: a successful block adds MP, the same bar special attacks spend)

camera._doc: D13: third-person orbit, camera zoom (../domain/controls.md#zoom); distance 0 = first person (D9).

climate._doc: D12: gen-climate numbers. Three seeded fields sampled once per land centre, normalised 0..1: temperature, humidity (fBm, frequency in lands), continent (oceans), relief (mountains). First matching rule wins; greenlands is the fallback.

combat._doc: D15 (2026-09-08): the multipliers the sources never state. attack = item damage curve × k × attack-power-mult; NPC damage mirrors enemy-hp; armor subtractive with a floor (settles the stats.json armor ?). Tune in play.

death.respawn-at: D15 hybrid: character's current spawn point (A: nearest revival statue; c-no-death-penalty)

starter-weapon._doc: player-character creation: first weapon-type of the class at this level/rarity

creature-roles._doc: D26 (2026-09-11): what a creature's combat-role does. A creatures.json row with no role uses `default`; `any-class` rolls one of the weighted roles per spawned group from the spawn rng (humanoids may be any class; role does not select class, equipment or appearance). melee = the reach attack (design.combat.enemy-attack). ranged / mage = a projectile role: the creature chases to `range` blocks, backs off below `keep-away`, needs line of sight, then winds up `windup-s` and fires `shot` (a c-moveset-config projectile dict, damage = creature damage × damage-mult, normal target damage rules so dodge / block / i-frames apply) and waits `cooldown-s`; `applies` are design.status-effects ids rolled onto the target on a landed shot (dodged or blocked shots carry no status, except poison, which dodge never avoids); `sfx` is the audio.json#sfx-alpha-ids sound played from the shooter, needing a design.feel.sfx entry; `color` tints the shot. `species` overrides any of those keys per creatures.json id. A creature shot never damages another creature (c-no-friendly-fire). Tune in play.

crit.overflow: crit chance above 1.0 adds to the multiplier (chance 1.5 → x2.5)

defence._doc: D23 (2026-09-11): the §3.3 dodge / combat-block / stealth runtimes and what a creature hit does to the player. dodge (../domain/controls.md#dodge): activation while moving rolls `distance` blocks over duration-s, ignoring every hit for iframe-s (poison excepted), costs stamina (c-dodge-cost), cannot start while stunned / busy / blocking, and the landing does no fall damage; on-dodge is keyed by the passive that grants it (elusiveness: +mp; way-of-the-shadows: +stealth), applied when the spec has that passive. block (../domain/controls.md#block): active request with a shield in the off-hand, or any weapon as a guardian (barricade), or while cyclone channels (every direction then); a hit whose attacker is in the front cone (dot of forward and the direction to it ≥ front-dot) is multiplied by 1 − damage-reduction, spends power-per-hit block-power and gives mp-per-block (D11 block-reward); block-power (0..max, guardian × guardian-mult) regenerates regen-per-s while not blocking (× cyclone-regen-mult during cyclone); at 0 the block drops until it regenerates; movement × move-mult while blocking. stealth: a 0..1 bar; buffs with stealth-per-s fill it (× still-mult while not moving), a stealth-full buff pins it at 1; with no source it decays decay-per-s; at s: attack × (1 + s × attack-mult-at-full), crit chance + s × crit-add-at-full, MP per hit × (1 + s × mp-mult-at-full), and creatures notice you from aggro-range × (1 − s × aggro-cut); a landed hit empties the bar unless a stealth-full buff holds it. enemy-hit: every creature hit that lands (not dodged, not blocked) rolls stun-chance and knockback-chance on the player with design.status-effects numbers (c-stun-immunity). Tune in play.

enemy-hp.formula: base-hp(lvl) * 200 * 2^(power-base * 0.25) * family-mult  (D14: the 200 is the NPC max-hp multiplier the sources never state)

enemy-level.rule: creature level rolled in band [min-party-level - below, max-party-level + above] (solo: own level); each land rolls a danger-tier at generation that fixes where in the band it sits

feel._doc: D25 (2026-09-11): feedback bundles per event: hit-stop-s sets the pace of game time to time-scale for that many real seconds (never stacked, the longer wins); trauma adds to the camera's 0..1 trauma (shake = trauma² × max-offset blocks on horizontal/vertical camera offset + max-roll-deg, decays decay-per-s, × shake-mult for accessibility); sfx = an alpha sound id (audio.json#sfx-alpha-ids) with a sound profile in design.feel.sfx; number = a floating damage number (over the target: rises rise-blocks over life-s, crit × crit-scale, colour by kind); flash = an impact sphere at the hit (impact-s, impact-radius or the splash radius). stun-stars: a '✶ ✶ ✶' label over any stunned entity's head while the stun lasts. buff-icons: one coloured box per active buff with its initial and a countdown fill (hud). level-up: the toast text and pop scale. projectile trail: a fading sphere every trail-every-s living trail-s. Tune in play.

frame-budget._doc: D17 (2026-09-08): physics tick rate and how many catch-up ticks one frame may run. Over budget = game time slows, FPS never collapses.

initial-encounters._doc: Initial hybrid ../domain/encounter-contracts.md: required complete village/site generation and local populations, independent of optional leading objects. Layout coordinates are derived from these dimensions; no ambient roster or global stat changes.

loot._doc: D18 (2026-09-09): gen-loot numbers the sources never state (loot-rule only says tier ±1). Per kill of a non-friendly creature, independent rolls: coins, one gear piece (gen-item), one consumable, species drops. Item power = clamp(power(creature level) ± level-spread, 1, 100), converting the source level before the existing power-point spread; coins keep creature-level units. Gear kind by weight; a weapon is a uniformly rolled class's weapon-type with its first listed material, armor uses that class's armor-material. This selection does not supply ring or amulet stat formulas. Tune in play.

ground._lifetime: ≈1 game week at 10× (c-time-speed); zone unload can retire it earlier

movement._doc: D13 (2026-09-08): player-character movement numbers, blocks and seconds; sources only say swim ≈ ½ walk and sprint ≈ mount speed. Tune in play.

hitbox._doc: capsule by race size-class (D13 settles the races.json stats ?): radius, height

movesets._doc: D24 (2026-09-11): weapon-type.m1 (../domain/controls.md#basic-attack) and .m2 (../domain/controls.md#special-attack), retained data-channel names, not physical bindings, per main-hand weapon-type; a weapon-type without an entry uses `default`, `as` copies another entry. kind melee = the D15 sphere in front of the camera yaw (radius × radius-mult, swing-s × swing-mult; `around` centres it on the player; `lunge` first moves the player that many blocks forward, stopped by walls; `finisher` rolls `applies` with `chance` on every `every`-th landed basic-attack hit); projectile = `count` shots from the eye along the camera aim (spread radians between them), each flying `speed` blocks/s under `gravity` blocks/s² for life-s, hitting the first body within `radius` (or exploding over `splash` blocks on any contact, terrain included); `pierce` keeps flying and re-hits every tick-s; `return` turns back at half life-s and homes to the player; beam = an instant ray along the aim up to `range`, striking `radius` around what it hits (or the ray end); at-cursor = an instant sphere of `radius` where the aim ray lands within `range`. Every kind takes weapon damage × damage-mult (basic attack adds the combo bonus, special attack the charge and stun roll) and carries `applies` (design.status-effects). A landed hit counts for combo / MP once per attack; an attack whose every shot lands nothing resets the combo (c-combo-reset). Ultimates: design.abilities runtime `projectile` (same keys, damage-mult of weapon damage, heal-pct on use) and a dash `throw` (projectiles thrown from the origin before the move). Tune in play.

names._doc: D12: gen-name land rule. name = 2-3 syllables, capitalised, + suffix by landscape (generators.json#names.land shape).

prices.calibration: alpha sell range 20 copper (+1) … 1s50 (+100) for white gear

progression._doc: D19 (2026-09-09): XP per kill, the number the sources never give. xp = xp-to-next(creature level) * kill-fraction * clamp(1 + gap-per-level * (creature level - player level), gap-mult-range); overflow carries; level-up refills HP; skill points banked at skill-points-per-level (stats.json).

recipes.armor: cotton table shape for every material

design.regeneration: stamina (D11: the Regeneration stat only regens stamina; HP regen comes from food, potions, bedroll)

resources._doc: D21: the MP bar (stats.json#resources.mp, c-mp-range). Non-mages gain per-hit on every landed basic attack (block, stealth and dodge gains follow their separate rules); mages regenerate mage-regen-per-s. Stamina numbers stay in design.movement.stamina.

settlement._doc: D22 (2026-09-10): gen-settlement for the hybrid, the sources never gave placement or layout numbers. One village per land (alpha count, c-land-count), placed from the land seed: the first candidate on rings of `search-step` blocks around the land centre whose column is ≥ min-above-sea above sea level; the terrain is flattened to that height within `radius` and blended over `blend` more (gen-terrain, no cliffs into town). Buildings are boxes [w, h, d] on a ring of `ring-radius` around the square, coloured by settlement-style ([wall, roof]) via style-by-landscape; one NPC per service building (npc-roles) stands at its door; houses are empty. E within interact-radius of an NPC = its service (ui.json#screens.npc-service): vendors open the shop (stock rolled from (world seed, village, shop): convert each actual land-danger/character-level source roll to power before the power-point spread and clamp to 1..100; unlimited consumables convert the character-level input directly without spread, land-shared supplier ceiling applied only at normal daily generation/restock, prices design.prices, sell = buy × design.prices.sell, worn gear cannot be sold), the class trainer refunds every spent point to the bank for respec-fee-per-level × level copper, the innkeeper heals fully and moves the respawn point to the inn (A: free). world.spawn-rule = near-village: new characters start on the square of the land (0,0) village. Wild spawns skip groups within no-hostiles-within blocks of the square (c-hostile-in-city). Tune in play.

skill-point._doc: D6 per-point scaling. D20 (2026-09-09) spend rules: one banked point per spend-skill-point request (../domain/controls.md#spend-skill-point); a node opens when the previous node of its column holds alpha-tree.needs points (roots 0); respec at the class trainer (settlements).

spawns._doc: D14 (2026-09-08): gen-spawns numbers for the open world (distinct from dungeon and settlement spawns). Rolled per 64² zone from (world seed, zone). Tune in play.

ai._doc: FSM idle → wander → chase (hostile, target in aggro range) → return (past leash). sim-radius (D16): creatures farther than this many blocks from the player are frozen — no AI, no physics (c-sim-radius).

special-attack._doc: D21: special-attack (../domain/controls.md#special-attack). Charged classes (classes.json special-attack-mode) hold the special-attack request: the charge fills at charge-mp-per-s up to the MP held (bar pink), release spends it; instant classes press. damage = weapon × (1 + charged/100 × (damage-mult-at-full − 1)), stun chance = charged/100 × stun-chance-at-full, hitbox = basic-attack's, no combo bonus, resets nothing (c-combo-reset applies: a whiff resets the combo). Below min-mp nothing happens.

stack-cap._doc: D6: no cap (0). D18 stack rule: only these item-types stack; gear carries a modifier roll and never stacks; pet food is one of each (c-stack-rule).

starting-inventory._doc: D18: hybrid start = the class starter weapon (design.combat.starter-weapon) equipped + 5 life potions (S: new characters start with 5) + no coins.

status-effects._doc: D21: effects of ability.applies (ids = status-effects.json). stun: the target cannot act (c-stun-immunity: not refreshed while it lasts); knockdown counts as a stun (`as`); knockback: horizontal impulse away from the caster (blocks/s); burning: ticks pct-of-hit of the hit that applied it; slow: move × move-mult. taunt: a 0-damage hit, which already makes the creature target you. poison (D24, dagger ambush): burning-style ticks of the whole hit at 1-5 s. Combat burns and poisons each retain independent damage, source, lifetime and schedule; burns tick at 0.5-4 s. No additional effect for stealth is specified here.

terrain._doc: D12 (2026-09-08): our world numbers; the sources never had them (alpha noise = x86 blob). Tune in play.
terrain.land-blend: relief/base bilinear over the 4 nearest land centres, so borders have no cliffs

time._doc: Hybrid game-clock: running time only; fresh saved worlds begin at 07:00.

key-items-s.rule: spawn only if lock type exists (harp→divine door, bell→crypt gate, whistle→bird statue, boat→water)

land.alpha-level: replaced (F4): party-level band + per-land danger tier → design.enemy-level

seed.steam: single fixed shared seed, random spawn

terrain.noise-params: unknown; alpha generator exists only as x86 code wrapped by cuwo tgen
terrain.roads: auto tunnels through mountains, bridges over canyons

invariants: terrain generated on the fly, no precompute
